newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai interbank rate, baht ease near close.
newsitem.headline: Thai interbank rate, baht ease near close.

text.p: The Thai overnight interbank rate extended its decline near the Friday close on sustained return of funds withdrawn during the festive season early this week, dealers said.

They said the overnight rate fell to a 11.00-11.75 percent range late on Friday from 12.00 in the morning and 12.50 late on Thursday. "The lower swap premium points to a downward trend for interbank rates," a dealer said.
The bid/offer range of the one-month dollar/baht swap premium fell to 8.80/9.50 satangs per dollar from 9.20/9.80 in the morning and 9.30/10.30 late Thursday.
Dealers said rising liquidity would partly be absorbed by demand by banks early next week to meet their cash reserve obligations by the January 7 deadline.

The baht eased to 25.618/25.623 to the dollar before the close from 25.615/25.618 early on Friday and 25.625/25.635 late on Thursday. The baht/dollar midrate stood unchanged at the Thursday level of 25.60.
"We see sustained demand for dollar because of its generally positive tone. Dollar traded on the upper side of the central bank midrate," he said.
